title: clusterMap of tpg-upgrade
description: The clusterMap input of the WorkflowTemplate tpg-upgrade: registered clusters, their keys and their instances. Generated from workflows/params/cluster-map-keys.yaml by workflows/params/clustermap_schema.py; the validate step of the workflow is the authority (registered clusters, required values an input may supply, combinations of values).

operatorVersion.description: Operator chart version of the cluster. tpg-day0: required (the key or the input operatorVersion); tpg-upgrade: the version to upgrade this cluster to [String (version); optional (default: the input operatorVersion)]

instances.description: The instances of the cluster (namespace pg-<instance>)

postgresVersion.description: tpg-day0, tpg-create-instance and tpg-upgrade: the version to deploy or upgrade to. Guard in the other workflows: when set, an instance that runs another version is skipped (SKIPPED_VERSION_MISMATCH) and nothing is changed for it [String (version); optional (default: the input postgresVersion)]

preUpgradeBackup.description: As the input [Boolean; optional (default: the input preUpgradeBackup)]

allowMajor.description: As the input: allow a major Postgres upgrade [Boolean; optional (default: the input allowMajor)]
